bio: This charming restaurant in the Rote Wand Gourmet Hotel serves traditional Austrian cuisine at its best, whether it's a perfectly souffléd Wiener schnitzel, delicious buttermilk pancakes or fabulous fondues! Diners can also look forward to cordial service and an extensive and well-curated selection of wines. At lunchtime, only the bistro is open, serving an à la carte menu. In the evening, culinary tradition is showcased in set menus with different options for each course....
